title: Fair Sunday weather in most parts of PH; 'habagat' to affect S. Luzon

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The southwest monsoon or “habagat” will prevail over the western section of Luzon while the rest of the country is expected to have fair weather with chances of rain on Sunday, according to the state weather bureau. In the 5 a.m. weather forecast of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), weather specialist Aldczar Aurelio also said that no low-pressure area or tropical cyclones were monitored in and around the Philippine area of responsibility.
